_about: Which Athena bot acts on a GitLab project, keyed on (host, top-level namespace) of the project (DND-1936). Read by ai/lib/forge-identity.sh for glab-athena, forge-preflight and push-actor-check. Public entries only: a work namespace's entry lives in the private overlay (overlay/gitlab.json .identities, same entry shape), never here. A namespace with no entry is refused, never given another bot or the owner's login. Entry fields: host (lowercase), namespace (exact case), bot (the GitLab username, or null with `pending` saying why), token_file (~/ or absolute; 0600, declared in ai/secrets/registry.json), refresh (self_rotate | group_service_account).

identities.pending: no bot writes here, and none should: custom and gen_saas live at gitlab.com/athena-ai-harness/ (DND-1947), and athena-ai-harness-bot is a member of that group only. Point the remote at the project's new path (git remote set-url origin git@gitlab.com:athena-ai-harness/<project>.git). This entry stays so a stale cjpoll/ remote is refused with this reason, not as an unknown namespace
